2609.20110.title: Perception, Layout, and Validation: Calibrated Confidence for Reliable Straight-Through Processing of Financial Documents
2609.20110.paper_summary: Straight-through processing (STP) on extracted key-value fields from financial documents without human review requires a calibrated probability together with a bounded guarantee on the residual error of the auto-approved tier. The emergence of modern Vision Language Models (VLMs) provides an out-of-the-box capability for extracting the key-values, but their verbalized confidence signals are unreliable and weakly track field correctness. This paper introduces a decomposed confidence layer along three interpretable channels, including perception, layout, and validation. Together with a final conformal risk control, the score can be used for reliable STP of financial documents. The method is validated on three public datasets covering real invoices, synthetic invoices, and ad-buy forms, using two different VLM families (Qwen3.6-27B and Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite). Our decomposed score consistently improves the separation of correct from incorrect extractions, substantially raising the AUROC from 0.54-0.74 for VLM verbalized signals to 0.90-0.99 with contributions from all three designed channels. Crucially for industrial deployment, this enables usable STP. The native VLM confidence signals could clear only 0.1%-7.0% of fields under risk control at a target error of <10%. In contrast, the proposed method auto-approves 49-72% of fields while holding the empirical error of the accepted tier at or below the target.
2609.20110.paper_summary_zh: 直通處理（STP）對於從金融文件中提取的關鍵值字段進行無人審核的處理，要求校準的概率以及對自動批准層的殘餘誤差的有界保證。現代視覺語言模型（VLMs）的出現提供了一種即時能力來提取關鍵值，但它們的口頭信心信號不可靠，且對字段正確性的追蹤能力較弱。本文介紹了一個分解的信心層，沿著三個可解釋的通道，包括感知、佈局和驗證。結合最終的符合風險控制，該分數可用於金融文件的可靠STP。該方法在三個公共數據集上進行了驗證，涵蓋真實發票、合成發票和廣告購買表單，使用兩個不同的VLM系列（Qwen3.6-27B和Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite）。我們的分解分數持續改善了正確與不正確提取的區分，將VLM口頭信號的AUROC從0.54-0.74大幅提升至0.90-0.99，並且所有三個設計通道均有所貢獻。對於工業部署而言，這對可用的STP至關重要。原生VLM信心信號在風險控制下僅能清除0.1%-7.0%的字段，目標誤差為<10%。相比之下，所提出的方法自動批准49-72%的字段，同時將接受層的實證誤差保持在目標水平或以下。
